item.title: Wyoming House committee supports Senate bill to modernize state grazing subleases
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — On Thursday, the Wyoming House Agriculture Committee approved legislation that would reshape how ranchers sublease state grazing lands and impose new requirements when livestock owned by someone else is placed on those leases. Senate File 0016, “Subleasing of state lands-exemptions,” passed on introduction to the Senate in a 28–2 vote on Feb. […]
